title: template
description: A kind's whole shape as a document to fill in, from template -o json and the board's GET …/designs/{design}/template, so a reader can start a new resource of that kind from it. A kind the design does not declare is refused with not_found, naming the kinds it does.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v2: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always Template, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

source.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v2, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: The kind's shape as one text.

text.description: One YAML document in the design form (design/v2): a resource of that kind to fill in, under the id asked for, each key with a comment hinting what it takes.
